content.comment_body: ************************************************************************ Industry Online Support Notification from product support for filter "Industrial Ethernet (Product Notification)" ************************************************************************ Dear Mr. [user_name], Product Notification - 1. Sales release for [product_name] Communication Module ([article_no]) ======================================================================== ------------------------------------------------------------------------ # Product Notification ------------------------------------------------------------------------ 1. Sales release for [product_name] Communication Module ([article_no]): Intranet (3/25/2015) [article_no] In addition to the previously available [product_name] Communication Module ([article_no]), the new [product_name] Communication Module ([article_no]) is now available for sales. Delivery is expected at the end of 03/2015. Please ensure you check country approvals regarding mobile communications for the product. DE: [url] EN: [url] For products: [article_no] More => [url] ------------------------------------------------------------------------ Please check the validity for the relevant products in every post (see "Order Number") ************************************************************************ Received the newsletter message today, but unfortunately the provided link ([url]) does not work.
Adds LTE (4G) and web server functionality to the previous communication module.

Hello [user_name], I am not sure why you received this email, as the link currently refers to an intranet page. The current public page for the delivery release is [url]. We are working to resolve this email issue. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are notified about the release of a new [product_name] communication module but encounter issues with a non-working link in the product support newsletter. One user highlights that the link leads to an internal page, resulting in difficulty in accessing expected public information. The improvements in the new module, such as LTE (4G) support and web server functionality, are noted. There are concerns about the reliability of communication and access to product information during announcements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect product support announcements to include accessible, working public links and easy access to comprehensive documentation for newly released hardware modules.
